# explosionprooftablets.com

> Engineering reference comparing ATEX and IECEx certified Zone 1 and Zone 2 tablets and iPad Ex solutions for hazardous areas, for HSE and procurement teams.

## What this site covers
- Zone 1 and Zone 2 (gas) and Zone 21/22 (dust) certified tablets under ATEX and IECEx
- Three approaches: dedicated Android Ex tablets, Windows Ex tablets, and certified cases or conversions for Apple iPads
- Protection concepts: intrinsic safety (Ex ia/ib/ic), flameproof enclosure (Ex db), increased safety (Ex ec)
- Specifications come from manufacturer certificates and datasheets. Prices are not listed; they are available on request.

## Solutions compared
- **Xshielder iPad Pro 11**, Xshielder (Norway): Zone 1/21, ATEX. Ex db flameproof case for the Apple iPad Pro 11" (M4/M5), iPadOS, ~1.4 kg.
- **ecom Tab-Ex 03 DZ1**, ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs): Zone 1, ATEX, IECEx. Android 13 tablet built on Samsung Galaxy Tab Active hardware, IP68, ~690 g.
- **ecom Tab-Ex Pro DZ1**, ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs): Zone 1, ATEX, IECEx. 10.1" AMOLED Android 13 tablet with S Pen, IP68, ~750 g.
- **i.safe MOBILE IS930.1**, i.safe MOBILE: Zone 1, ATEX, IECEx. Compact 8" IPS Android 12 tablet, IP68, ~570 g.
- **Aegex 10 IS**, Aegex Technologies: Zone 1, ATEX, IECEx. 10.1" IPS Windows 10/11 tablet, IP65, ~850 g.
- **Bartec Agile X IS**, Bartec: Zone 1, ATEX, IECEx. Windows 10 IoT tablet for Zone 1.
- **Getac F110-Ex**, Getac: Zone 2, ATEX. 11.6" IPS Windows 11 tablet, IP66, ~1.4 kg.
- **Zebra XPAD L10 IS**, Zebra (Xplore): Zone 2, ATEX, IECEx. 10.1" Android or Windows tablet, IP65, ~1.1 kg.
- **Xciel XCZ1 iPad mini 7**, Xciel (USA): Zone 1, ATEX, IECEx. Flameproof enclosure for the iPad mini 4–7, factory-fitted only.
- **Atexxo iPad 11" Zone 1**, Atexxo Manufacturing (Netherlands): Zone 1/21, ATEX, IECEx. Announced: converted Apple iPad 11", ~1,100 g.
- **Atexxo iPad (A16) Ex**, Atexxo Manufacturing (Netherlands): Zone 2/22, ATEX. Factory-converted Apple iPad 11" (A16), ~1,050 g.
- **Xciel XCRiPad Pro 11**, Xciel (USA): Zone 2, ATEX, US C1D2. Rugged Ex case for the iPad Pro 11"; versions for iPad, iPad Air and iPad mini too.
